# MemMapAnon

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Maps fresh zeroed memory, backed by no object, into the caller's address space.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0B` SVC_MANAGEMEMORY | `MNGMEM_MAP (0) (HANDLE_ANON)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
void * MemMapAnon(size_t size, VirtAddr hint_va, MemProt prot);
```

**Registers:** `(HANDLE_ANON, size, hint | prot) -> r0 address or error`

Pages are allocated on first touch.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | in | Size in bytes. |
| `hint_va` | in | Page-aligned address to map at, or 0 to let the kernel choose. |
| `prot` | in | PROT_READ / PROT_WRITE / PROT_EXEC. |

## Returns

The mapped address, or an error encoded as a pointer; check with PtrIsErr().

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | `size` or `hint_va` is unusable. |
| [`ERR_OVERFLOW`](../errors.md#err_overflow) | `size` is too large. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | No address space left. |
